name: Ribatejada (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ribatejada (a church tower on blue).
history: Ribatejada adopted its arms and flag officially in 1999, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 2 March 2000; the flag is of proportions 2/3, a yellow cloth with the municipal arms over all at the centre.

features.role: Ribatejada arms — church tower on blue
